name: betterbooks
description: A modern bookkeeping application for small business owners

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.test: cd frontend && npm test && cd ../backend && npm test
